reusable_knowledge: MPS planning formula: net_requirement = max(0, gross - (opening_on_hand + scheduled_receipt - safety_stock)); planned receipt rounds net up to a multiple of lot_size; projected_on_hand = opening + scheduled_receipt + receipt - gross_requirement.
